title: Tool meridian of a sharp taper or a drill misses the radial shoulder when the flute is shorter than the cone

labels.name: P1
labels.description: Unsafe or wrong output: gouge, collision, wrong G-code, crash, data loss; blocks a cut

labels.name: effort:high
labels.description: Several crates, new behaviour with tests; safety floor (issue-worker-high)

body:
## What happens

`Tool::meridian()` (`crates/tools/src/meridian.rs`) and `Tool::profile()` disagree for a sharp tapered mill or a drill when the flute length is shorter than the cone. The profile steps out to the full radius at the flute top. The meridian does not add that radial shoulder, so it ends at a smaller radius.

The review of PR #3929 found this class for flat and ball taper tips (review comment 7144791597). PR #3929 fixes it for the new flat and ball tips only (`crates/tools/src/taper.rs`, `meridian_points`). It does not change sharp tapers or drills, because that PR keeps their output byte-identical. The same missing shoulder stays on `main` for sharp tapers and drills.

## Why it matters

The two shapes describe the same tool. If code reads the meridian for a collision, gouge, simulation or solid, it sees a smaller tool than the profile and the real cutter. That can hide a contact. The filer has not traced each reader of the meridian; this needs a check before the priority is set.

## What to check

- Each reader of the tool meridian for milling tools (sim tool bodies, solids, fidelity checks, stamps).
- A sharp taper and a drill with a flute shorter than the cone: compare `profile()` and `meridian()` at the flute top. A test in the style of `taper::tests::short_flat_profile_and_meridian_agree` (PR #3929) shows the gap.

## Done means

For every tool kind, the meridian and the profile agree at the flute top, including the radial shoulder of a short flute. A test pins a sharp taper and a drill with a short flute. Any changed digest or golden is listed in the PR.

The account that files this issue cannot set labels. A collaborator: please set the priority (P1 if a collision or gouge check reads the meridian, else P3), `bug`, an effort label, the area label and `source:agent`.

Found while fixing #3929.
